_about: HomeTV design tokens: the household app's design system (Ghar Ledger) fonts, accents and components, on neutral graphite surfaces (ADR-0009). Source of truth for helper/web/app.css :root and the native apps. Token names match Ghar Ledger's.

surface.use: Rail, tab bar, top bar, cards, channel list, guide headers, dialogs

surface2.use: Buttons, chips, inputs, logo tiles, guide programmes, hover

surface3.use: Selected and focused rows, current guide programme, button hover

ink3.use: Tertiary text, times, labels, inactive tabs

us.use: Primary accent (teal), used sparingly: primary buttons, selected chips, active tab, progress, now line, ratings, links, the edge/ring on selections

usSoft.use: Not used for selections any more (they are neutral). Kept for parity with the household app

in.use: Secondary accent (saffron): catch-up icons and badges

ui.use: Everything except numbers and big titles. Headings are Figtree 600

num.use: Big titles (hero, detail, page titles, guide and preview headlines), channel numbers, times, time left, ratings, the clock. Weight 700, letter-spacing -0.02em

font.rootSize: clamp(15px, 0.45vw + 11px, 24px); 15px on iPhone portrait; 14px on iPhone landscape
font.label: Eyebrows and small labels: 0.72-0.75em, weight 600, letter-spacing 0.08-0.09em, uppercase (Ghar's .eyebrow / .flabel)

radius.control: 12px (inputs, icon buttons, nav items, group rows)
radius.l: 22px (dialogs, preview, settings cards; phone bottom sheets 22px top corners)

components.button: surface2 + 1px line border, 13px radius, Figtree 600. Primary: teal fill, ground text
components.chip: pill, surface2 + 1px line border, ink2 text; hover border teal; selected: teal fill, ground text
components.tabBar: iPhone: surface at 96% with 12px blur, line2 top border, labels 0.68em, active = teal icon and label
components.rail: iPad/desktop/TV: surface, line2 right border, same active treatment as the tab bar
components.bottomSheet: iPhone dialogs rise from the bottom, 22px top corners, scrim rgba(8,9,11,.66)
components.toast: ink background, ground text, 15px radius; inset 12px on iPhone
components.focus: 2px teal outline (buttons, chips); rows, programmes and episodes turn surface3 grey with a 2px teal inset ring; cards get a 3px teal ring and lift
components.segmented: Two or more options in a surface2 track (1px line border, 14px radius, 4px padding); options 44px min height, 10px radius; selected = teal fill with ground text; arrow keys move the selection
components.monoField: MAC address, serial and device IDs: ui-monospace stack ('SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas), upper case, letter-spacing .03em
components.fieldError: Inline under the field: coral text .88em weight 500; the field gets a coral border and a 3px coral ring at 25%
components.notice: Information to read before acting (not an error): surface2 box, 1px line border, 13px radius, info icon in warn yellow, ink2 text with a bold ink lead-in

phone.nav: Top bar (brand, Search, Settings) + bottom tab bar (Home, Live TV, Guide, Movies, Series)

tablet.live: Two columns: chips + channel list | preview

wide.live: Three columns: groups | channel list | preview

motion.heroRotate: 9 s, paused on hover/focus, off with prefers-reduced-motion
motion.rise: .26 s cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.3,1) for sheets and dialogs (Ghar's rise)

touch.press: scale .97, or the teal tint on rows
